List installed plugins

## Synopsis

```text
List installed plugins. By default each plugin appears once, at its highest semver. Use --all to show every installed version.
```

```text
finfocus plugin list [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # List the latest installed version of each plugin
  finfocus plugin list

  # List every installed version and mark the one core uses
  finfocus plugin list --all

  # List plugins with detailed information
  finfocus plugin list --verbose

  # List available plugins from registry
  finfocus plugin list --available

  # List plugins as JSON for machine consumption
  finfocus plugin list --output json
```

## Options

```text
      --all[=true|false]         List every installed version and mark the one core uses
      --available[=true|false]   List available plugins from registry
  -h, --help[=true|false]        help for list
      --output string            Output format (table, json) (default "table")
      --verbose[=true|false]     Show detailed plugin information
```
